answer: Tin ingots and bright sheets lie on the whitesmith's bench. nebula cuts the sheet to the pattern and folds the edges over. Proof of whitesmith via tinned pan tally — a pan the whitesmith tins only after 1433 pans tin true without one pan blistering at the seam, each tinned by the whitesmith himself. sparrow fluxes the joint and runs the solder along the seam. zephyr tests the finished pan with water and checks for pinholes. One thousand four hundred and thirty-three pans must tin true without one pan blistering at the seam, and the next still blisters where the tin ran thin.
